FIELD.name: s_ra
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Central Spatial Position in ICRS Right ascension

FIELD.name: s_dec
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Central Spatial Position in ICRS Declination

FIELD.name: facility_name
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Name of telescope used to acquire observation

FIELD.name: instrument_name
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Name of instrument used to acquire observation

FIELD.name: dataproduct_subtype
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Product type (e.g. science, calibration, auxiliary, preview, info)

FIELD.name: calib_level
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Calibration level of the observation: in {0, 1, 2, 3, 4}

FIELD.name: dataproduct_type
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Data product (file content) primary type

FIELD.name: energy_bandpassname
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Collection-specific name for energy band (e.g. filter name)

FIELD.name: energy_emband
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Generic name for energy band (Radio,Millimeter,Infrared,Optical,...)

FIELD.name: obs_id
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Internal ID given by the ObsTAP service

FIELD.name: s_resolution
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Spatial resolution (FWHM)

FIELD.name: em_min
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Lower bound on energy axis (barycentric wavelength)

FIELD.name: em_max
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Upper bound on energy axis (barycentric wavelength)

FIELD.name: em_res_power
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Spectral resolving power (R)

FIELD.name: proposal_title
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Proposal title

FIELD.name: access_url
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: URI for the physical artifact

FIELD.name: access_format
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Content-Type of the representation at uri

FIELD.name: access_estsize
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Estimated size of the download at uri

FIELD.name: t_exptime
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Exposure time per pixel

FIELD.name: s_region
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: AstroCoordArea Region covered in STC

FIELD.name: obs_collection
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Data collection this observation belongs to

FIELD.name: obs_intent
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Intended purpose of data (one of: science, calibration)

FIELD.name: algorithm_name
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Algorithm that defines the observation

FIELD.name: facility_keywords
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Telescope keywords formatted as a JSON string

FIELD.name: instrument_keywords
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Instrument keywords formatted as a JSON string

FIELD.name: environment_photometric
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Conditions were photometric (0=false, 1=true)

FIELD.name: proposal_id
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Collection-specific unique proposal identifier

FIELD.name: proposal_pi
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Proposal principal investigator

FIELD.name: proposal_project
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Project that created/acquired the observation

FIELD.name: target_name
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Name of intended target

FIELD.name: target_type
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Classification of intended target ('object' or 'field')

FIELD.name: target_standard
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Intended target is a standard (0=false, 1=true)

FIELD.name: target_moving
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Intended target is moving (0=false, 1=true)

FIELD.name: target_keywords
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Target keywords formatted as a JSON string

FIELD.name: obs_release_date
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Timestamp of date the data becomes publicly available

FIELD.name: s_xel1
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Dimensions (number of pixels) along first spatial axis

FIELD.name: s_xel2
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Dimensions (number of pixels) along second spatial axis

FIELD.name: s_pixel_scale
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Sample (pixel) size on spatial axes

FIELD.name: position_timedependent
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Position is time-dependent (0=false, 1=true)

FIELD.name: t_min
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Lower bound on time axis (Modified Julian Day)

FIELD.name: t_max
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Upper bound on time axis (Modified Julian Day)

FIELD.name: t_resolution
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Resolution on the time axis

FIELD.name: t_xel
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Dimensions (number of pixels) along the time axis

FIELD.name: obs_publisher_did
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: IVOA Dataset ID given by the publisher

FIELD.name: s_fov
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Estimated size of the covered region as the diameter of a containing circle

FIELD.name: em_xel
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Dimensions (number of pixels) along the energy axis

FIELD.name: pol_states
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: List of polarization states present in the data file

FIELD.name: pol_xel
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Dimensions (number of pixels) along the polarization axis

FIELD.name: cloud_access
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: URI for the enclouded artifact

FIELD.name: o_ucd
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: UCD describing the observable axis (pixel values)
